Name matching is accent-insensitive and code/parent candidates are explicitly reported.

sources.title: Merged sibling geography packet #497 / PR #565
sources.scope_relation: Disjoint 89 IDs in sibling #497 plus 228 IDs in #496; the two exact issue ID sets have empty intersection; Peru area members form 89 + 115 = 204.

inspected_facts.classification: One correction-needed administrative role/source-vintage mismatch (Las Golondrinas). Remaining subjects have sourced administrative identity but unresolved physical/settlement and semantic-tier completeness; no subject is marked justified solely from structure.

unresolved_source_work.settlements: No authoritative point settlement or complete named-place dataset was reconciled against the 228 polygons. Province/canton administrative roster and population tables are not settlement inventories.
unresolved_source_work.physical_geography: No authoritative shoreline, named island, hydrographic, lake/islet or enclave inventory was reconciled. Galápagos canton component identities and five inland interior rings remain open.
unresolved_source_work.latest_admin_source: The 2024 Ecuador gazetteer lacks the 2019/2023 Zona No Delimitada records; authoritative effective-date and geometry crosswalk for Las Golondrinas/Manga del Cura remains a coordinated source restoration item under #495/#496 and integration #489.

notes: This register records geographic administrative identity separately from physical land and political ownership. Source byte hashes do not certify semantic suitability or topology.
